page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("iudicio"), so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The whole text block is one paragraph in the scan, with no indented line starts I could confirm; this is a judgement from line endings. Three marginal notes on the left: "Meldenses Lutetiam abducti.", "Arestū fe-natus Pari-fiensis." and "Nomina xiiii.exu-storum.", placed beside the lines where they stand. "Parisiensem" and "Meldensè" were read with some uncertainty. "ignominia" at the foot is the catchword, underlined with a decorative flourish. The printed text shows a broken hyphen at "Melde-fe," which I have written as "Meldensè" in the main line; that word may need checking against the scan.
